summary.text: Adam Mathews is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 56 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. An attorney, he is vice chair of the Energy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mathews graduated from St. Xavier High School and earned a bachelor’s degree and a law degree from the University of Notre Dame in 2010 and 2013.
His career experience includes working as a lawyer, small business owner, engineer and substitute teacher.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he studied mechanical engineering and political science at Notre Dame, worked at Procter & Gamble and as a civilian for the Navy Nuclear Propulsion Program, and has practiced as a small business and patent attorney.
Mathews won the District 56 seat in 2022 by defeating Joy Bennett and was re-elected in 2024 over Cleveland Canova.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism; Energy (vice chair); Judiciary; and Public Insurance and Pensions committees.

In the 2026 survey, he said he sponsored the bills that became Ohio’s 2.75% flat income tax and listed continuing to phase down the income tax and expanding the homestead exemption among his next goals.
